resources.string: Make your status bar yours with Wi-Fi and battery styles.
A cyan and violet energy ring with the live battery percentage when wired charging starts.
System tools and screen capture settings.
Allow screenshots and screen recordings of app windows that use FLAG_SECURE. Off by default. DRM-protected video may remain blank.
Testing only: allow APK updates signed with a different key for ordinary user-installed apps. Off by default; available in userdebug builds. System and shared-UID apps stay protected.
This allows an unrelated APK to replace an installed app and access its existing data. Enable only for trusted APKs during testing, then switch it off.
Available only to the device owner on userdebug builds.
